Lernen or Studieren? German A1 Word-Choice Practice

Choose lernen for learning and studieren for university study. Compare everyday skills, revision and degree subjects with explained answers.

A1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions + writing task

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Understand the difference

Lernen means learning or studying material and skills: Deutsch lernen, für einen Test lernen. Studieren commonly means following a university degree or subject: Medizin studieren. English study can translate into either verb, so identify the kind of activity rather than matching one English word.

Common mistake to avoid

Do not use studieren for every study session. Ich lerne Vokabeln describes vocabulary revision; Ich studiere Biologie describes a university subject.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Compare the meaning and sentence pattern, rather than choosing by English translation alone.

Worked example 1Nele lernt gerade neue Redewendungen.Nele is learning new expressions at the moment.
Worked example 2Arjun studiert Maschinenbau an einer Hochschule.Arjun studies mechanical engineering at a university.
Worked example 3Wir lernen für den Vokabeltest am Dienstag.We are studying for Tuesday’s vocabulary test.
Worked example 4Meine Cousine studiert Architektur in Weimar.My cousin studies architecture in Weimar.

Practice: choose the right word

Choose a present-tense form of lernen or studieren. Use the cue to distinguish acquiring/revising material from a university degree. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Ich ___ jeden Tag zehn neue Wörter. (learning vocabulary)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: lerne

Use lernen for acquiring vocabulary.

Question 2. Farid ___ Medizin an der Universität. (degree subject)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: studiert

A university degree subject commonly takes studieren.

Question 3. Wir ___ für den Test morgen. (revision)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: lernen

Revising for a test is für den Test lernen.

Question 4. ___ du Jura an einer Hochschule? (university degree)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: Studierst

Use studieren for a degree subject; du takes studierst.

Use it in your own sentence

Contrast learning German with studying law at university.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Ich lerne Deutsch, und meine Schwester studiert Jura.

Check your wording: Lernen describes language learning; studieren describes the degree subject.

What to practise next

Write a new context for each word. Explain which meaning or object pattern makes your choice natural; some contexts allow both.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
